items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I worked out in Minneapolis with Herb Hall.

ctx.x: Spencer Clark was on my recording of 'We Just Couldn't Say Goodbye'. But there are alot of jazz societies scattered all over the United States. I worked out in Minneapolis with Herb Hall. There is the Hall Brothers out there. Real traditional dixieland jazz. And this is where I ran into a man by the name of Bill Drake. He's in the paper somewhere and he likes to play the drums. And most of these traditional jazz bands are made up of guys who just want to play - they want to play dixieland. So that's the crowd I…
